segments.zh: 有些人的头发很薄，所以他们没有很多头发。

segments.en: Okay, good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And well, moving on to the parts of the face, we described it before as to where a mustache is, where a goatee is, but let's take a closer look at that.
segments.zh: 好吧，继续说到脸的各个部分，我们之前描述过胡须在哪里，山羊胡子在哪里，但让我们仔细看看。

segments.en: For example, a mustache is on your upper lip.
segments.zh: 例如，你的上唇留着小胡子。

segments.en: Right, so just above your lip, under your nose, that's where a mustache goes.
segments.zh: 是的，就在你的嘴唇上方，在你的鼻子下，这就是胡须的地方。

segments.en: So that's the upper lip.
segments.zh: 所以这就是上唇。

segments.en: But if we're talking about a goatee, it's not just on your upper lip, it's also where?
segments.zh: 但如果我们谈论的是山羊胡子，它不仅仅是在你的上唇上，它也是在哪里？

segments.en: On your chin.
segments.zh: 在你的下巴上。

segments.en: Your chin.
segments.zh: 你的下巴。

segments.en: So that's the very bottom point of your face.
segments.zh: 所以这是你脸上的最底层。

segments.en: So you have your chin, your upper lip, and also when we talked about, for example, the sideburns, we talked about the jaw, but also it could be part of the cheek.
segments.zh: 所以你有你的下巴，你的上唇，当我们谈到鬓角时，我们谈到了下巴，但它也可能是脸颊的一部分。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So every person has two cheeks, one on the left and one on the right, and those are a very big part of your face on the sides of your nose.
segments.zh: 所以每个人都有两个脸颊，一张在左边，一个在右边，这些是你鼻子两侧的脸的很大一部分。

segments.en: Okay, so you have your chin, you have your cheeks, you have your upper lip.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你有你的下巴，你有你的脸颊，你有你的上唇。

segments.en: I think that's pretty much the only places where you can grow a mustache.
segments.zh: 我认为这几乎是你唯一可以长出小胡子的地方。

segments.en: Also on your neck.
segments.zh: 也在你的脖子上。

segments.en: Yeah, some people have it on their neck or on the back of, well, no, it's not better.
segments.zh: 是的，有些人把它戴在脖子上或后面，嗯，不，它不是更好。

segments.en: Some people also have it on their neck, yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 有些人的脖子上也有它，是的，没错。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So a lot of different words to describe facial hair.
segments.zh: 所以很多不同的词来形容面部毛发。

segments.en: Why don't we go back, listen to the dialogue one last time, and we'll be back to talk some more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回去，最后一次听对话，我们会再回来谈谈。

segments.en: Okay, Sally, we have an artist here to help us.
segments.zh: 好吧，莎莉，我们有一位艺术家在这里帮助我们。

segments.en: We'll ask you questions about the bank robber you saw and Paul will draw a picture.
segments.zh: 我们会问你关于你看到的银行劫匪的问题，保罗会画一幅画。

segments.en: Are you ready?
segments.zh: 你准备好了吗？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Well, he had brown hair, long hair, and he had some facial hair.
segments.zh: 嗯，他有一头棕色的头发，长发，还有一些胡须。

segments.en: It was brown too.
segments.zh: 也是棕色的。

segments.en: Good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Okay, the facial hair, was it a beard or a mustache?
segments.zh: 那胡子是在下巴上，还是嘴唇上方的小胡子？

segments.en: Both.
segments.zh: 两者都。

segments.en: His mustache was very short and thin, just on the top of his lip.
segments.zh: 他的小胡子又短又薄，就在他的嘴唇上。

segments.en: Ah-ha, hmm, like this?
segments.zh: 啊哈，嗯，是这样的吗？

segments.en: Yes, that's the mustache, but the beard isn't right.
segments.zh: 是的，那是胡须，但胡须是不对的。

segments.en: I mean, it didn't cover his whole face.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，它没有覆盖他的整个脸。

segments.en: I think it was just on his chin.
segments.zh: 我想这只是在他的下巴上。

segments.en: A goatee?
segments.zh: 山羊胡？

segments.en: Was it like Paul's?
segments.zh: 像保罗那样的吗？

segments.en: Uh, yes, that's it.
segments.zh: 嗯，对，就是那样。

segments.en: He had a goatee.
segments.zh: 他留着山羊胡。

segments.en: Okay, now what about sideburns?
segments.zh: 好吧，现在怎么办？

segments.en: Did he have sideburns?
segments.zh: 他有鬓角吗？

segments.en: Um, yes, they were long and thick, like yours.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，它们又长又厚，和你的一样。

segments.en: Alright, there, was this the man you saw?
segments.zh: 好吧，那是你看到的那个人吗？

segments.en: Yes, that's him.
segments.zh: 对，就是他。

segments.en: Hmm, he looks a lot like you.
segments.zh: 嗯，他长得很像你。

segments.en: Hmm, why, yes he does.
segments.zh: 嗯，为什么，是的，他会的。

segments.en: Paul, where were you on Friday afternoon?
segments.zh: 保罗，星期五下午你在哪里？

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: That's ridiculous.
segments.zh: 太荒唐了。

segments.en: It wasn't me.
segments.zh: 不是我。

segments.en: I didn't do anything.
segments.zh: 我什么也没做。

segments.en: I was over there doing the thing with the best man.
segments.zh: 我在那边和最好的人一起做这件事。

segments.en: Alright, so talking about facial hair, Catherine, do you like men that have facial hair?
segments.zh: 好吧，说到面部毛发，凯瑟琳，你喜欢有胡子的男人吗？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Yeah, you like mustaches, beards, goatees?
segments.zh: 是的，你喜欢胡子，胡须，山羊胡子？

segments.en: Um, well it really depends.
segments.zh: 嗯，这真的取决于。

segments.en: I really like sideburns, but sometimes people don't do them correctly, so I don't like them.
segments.zh: 我真的很喜欢鬓角，但有时人们做得不正确，所以我不喜欢它们。

segments.en: But I like beards, and yeah, goatee, I like facial hair.
segments.zh: 但我喜欢胡须，是的，山羊胡，我喜欢胡须。

segments.en: You like facial hair.
segments.zh: 你喜欢面部毛发。

segments.en: What is it about facial hair on men that you like?
segments.zh: 你喜欢的男人的面部毛发是什么？

segments.en: Manly men.
segments.zh: 男子气概的男人。

segments.en: I don't know, there's something, you know, kind of rough about it.
segments.zh: 我不知道，有什么，你知道的，有点粗糙。

segments.en: Rough, yeah.
segments.zh: 粗糙，是的。

segments.en: Yeah, I don't like the very manicured, very carefully cut facial hair.
segments.zh: 是的，我不喜欢修剪得非常精心剪裁的面部毛发。

segments.en: I kind of like it a little bit more on the rough side.
segments.zh: 我有点喜欢粗糙的一面。

segments.en: Oh, okay.
segments.zh: 哦，好吧。

segments.en: It's interesting because, it's interesting to see also facial hair, or long facial hair.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，因为它也很有趣，也可以看到面部毛发或长长的面部毛发。

segments.en: Like for example, the guys from ZZ Top.
segments.zh: 例如，来自 ZZ Top 的人。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You know, they have like really long beards.
segments.zh: 你知道，他们的胡须很长。

segments.en: I wonder how long it takes to grow something like this.
segments.zh: 我想知道长出这样的东西需要多长时间。

segments.en: I'm sure we could find out on the internet, but yeah, no, they have competitions.
segments.zh: 我相信我们可以在互联网上找到，但是，不，他们有比赛。

segments.en: There's a world mustache competition, for example, and they have the world's longest mustache.
segments.zh: 例如，世界上有一场小胡子比赛，他们有世界上最长的小胡子。

segments.en: So they measure his mustache, it's three or four meters or something.
segments.zh: 所以他们测量他的小胡子，三四米左右。

segments.en: Yeah, it can get really long.
segments.zh: 是的，它可以变得很长。

segments.en: Yeah, so I think your hair keeps growing.
segments.zh: 是的，所以我认为你的头发会一直长大。

segments.en: It just depends on when you decide to cut it.
segments.zh: 这仅取决于您何时决定削减它。

segments.en: I think it's also a very cultural thing, right?
segments.zh: 我认为这也是一个非常文化的东西，对吧？

segments.en: Some cultures are able to grow a lot of facial hair and like to do it.
segments.zh: 一些文化能够长出大量的面部毛发并喜欢这样做。

segments.en: Others really don't.
segments.zh: 其他人真的没有。

segments.en: For example, you don't really see many Asians with facial hair, with goatees or mustaches.
segments.zh: 例如，你并没有真正看到许多留着胡须、留着山羊胡子或胡须的亚洲人。

segments.en: I think you see more goatees than you see full beards, actually.
segments.zh: 我想你看到的山羊胡子比你看到的胡须还多。

segments.en: But yeah, definitely East Asia, it's not as common.
segments.zh: 但是，是的，当然是东亚，这并不常见。

segments.en: Although India, you see a lot a little bit more facial.
segments.zh: 虽然印度，你会看到更多的面部。

segments.en: A lot of mustaches there.
segments.zh: 那里有很多胡须。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So this is an interesting question.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个有趣的问题。

segments.en: Tell us how popular it is in your country or if you like men with facial hair or if you're a guy, do you like to have a beard, a mustache or a goatee?
segments.zh: 告诉我们它在你的国家有多受欢迎，或者你喜欢面部毛发的男人，或者如果你是一个男人，你喜欢留胡子、留胡子还是山羊胡子？
